Performance Services

Tuning and upgrade paths.

Stage 1 ECU Calibration Support

  • Intake/exhaust readiness check
  • Baseline scan before calibration
  • Datalog review after install
  • Street drivability and throttle behavior inspection

Stage 2 Hardware Packages

  • Downpipes, midpipes and exhaust components
  • Heat exchanger, intercooler and cooling support
  • Spark plug, coil and fuel-system review
  • Post-upgrade leak check and scan report

TCU / Transmission Behavior

  • Shift strategy support for dual-clutch and ZF platforms
  • Launch-control readiness review
  • Fluid condition inspection
  • Torque-limit and drivability coordination with tuner

Track Preparation

  • Brake pad and rotor selection
  • High-temp fluid service
  • Alignment for tire wear and turn-in
  • Fastener, hub, tire and cooling inspection
Paint & Styling

Finish work that looks intentional, not aftermarket.

Paint and styling work should respect the factory lines. The goal is clean fitment, proper panel flow and finishes that look expensive in daylight and under shop lighting.

Paint / StylingBMW M8 Competition

Paint Correction

  • Wash, decontamination and clay process
  • Single-stage or multi-stage correction
  • Gloss restoration for dark colors and reds
  • Panel-by-panel inspection under shop lighting

Wrap & Color Change Prep

  • Surface preparation before vinyl
  • Trim removal planning
  • Blackout packages and accent stripes
  • Post-install edge inspection

Ceramic Coating

  • Paint correction before coating
  • Wheel-face coating options
  • Glass and trim protection
  • Maintenance wash process explained at pickup

Aero & Exterior Trim

  • Front lips, splitters and side skirts
  • Carbon trim fitting
  • Rear diffuser and spoiler install
  • Fitment checked before final mounting
Vehicle Coverage

Platforms we understand.

BMW M / AMG / Audi RS

Turbocharged German platforms need cooling, plugs, coils, transmission behavior and traction considered before chasing power numbers.

Corvette / Mustang / Mopar

American performance responds well to tire, brake, alignment, exhaust and cooling upgrades before track or spirited street use.

Classic Cars

Older platforms need restraint: safety first, clean wiring, carb/fuel delivery checks, braking confidence and preservation of the car's character.
